name: Queensland University of Technology
summary: Brisbane university with Gardens Point and Kelvin Grove campuses; practical degrees in engineering, IT, business, design, health and law.

ib.text: QUT sets entry thresholds per course and lists the International Baccalaureate Diploma as a qualifying Year 12 route. Check the course page and QUT's IB guide for the IB total; assumed knowledge is in Queensland terms.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Engineering (Honours)
programmes.about: A four-year honours degree with ten specialisations from Civil and Mechanical to Machine Learning Systems and Medical, 60 days of work experience in an Australian engineering environment, and a double-degree option.
programmes.ib: Assumed knowledge is Mathematical Methods or Specialist Mathematics (Queensland); QUT's ATAR threshold for Year 12 applicants is 84. Ask QUT for the IB total.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your Year 12 result against the course's threshold; the Year 12 ATAR threshold is 84 and the IB total is in QUT's IB guide.

flagshipSource.title: Bachelor of Engineering (Honours): ten specialisations, 60 days of work experience, a double-degree option

notes: Some courses with auditions, interviews or portfolios have their own closing dates, shown on the course page; QUT publishes no single international closing date.
QUT advises applying as soon as you can, because the application and student visa processes take time.
Thresholds on QUT's page for international Year 12 students are ATARs for the Australian curriculum, not IB totals.

sources.title: QUT: ATAR acceptance thresholds for international Year 12 students
